candidates.name: canonical_charge_lexicon_memory
candidates.hypothesis: The largest miss bucket (~26/100) is a naming failure, not a reasoning failure: the model names the right conduct with a non-statutory string and exact-match scoring gives it zero. If the system harvests an exact-string lexicon from every observed ground truth and deterministically rewrites its own answer into a lexicon member before returning it, those items convert without changing how the model reasons. Verbatim whole-payload rules must be tried before per-part resolution, because some needed rewrites (e.g. a two-character colloquial name to a statutory one) share no characters with the target and are unrecoverable by any similarity metric.
components: statutory-string lexicon harvested from ground truth
part-wise alignment rules on equal-cardinality pairs
deterministic output normalization, no extra LLM call
lexicon injected into the prompt as allowed vocabulary
terse single retry on empty output

candidates.name: act_decomposition_union_memory
candidates.hypothesis: A single call over a long multi-act narrative collapses to the most salient charge, so facts whose target holds 2-3 charges score zero (~8/100), and the same whole-narrative call invites extra charges (~4/100). If the fact is segmented into acts on structural markers and each act is charged in its own short call with the union assembled system-side, the undercount is recovered; a learned answer-cardinality prior conditioned on the detected act count then trims surplus, on the condition that the prior is only a prior — it may not cut below the number of acts that each independently produced a charge, and a size bucket is trusted only after a minimum number of observations.
components: act segmentation on structural markers with paragraph fallback
one LLM call per act, union assembled system-side
spurious-invention memory strips recurring unconfirmed charges
answer-cardinality prior conditioned on detected act count
grounded floor: prior never cuts below per-act evidenced charges
MIN_BUCKET_OBS guard before a size bucket is consulted
terse per-act retry when an act yields nothing
no string rewriting and no statutory-name inventory (deliberately disjoint from candidate A)
